svg.title: A short timeline of the mechanism's modern study
svg.desc: A linear timeline from 1900 to 2021: the 1900 discovery, the 1902 recognition of the gears, Price in 1974, the 2005 scans, the 2006 to 2008 solution of the back, and the 2021 front cosmos model.

text.font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: From a corroded lump to a readable machine

text.font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: A linear scale, 1900 to 2021. The ship itself went down about two thousand years earlier.
